description: This source file defines a helper module for handling guardrails in passthrough endpoints within a larger software project. It includes classes and static methods to normalize configurations, determine if guardrails are enabled, retrieve guardrail names and settings, prepare request/response data, execute guardrails, and handle field-level targeting using JSONPath expressions. The module is designed to facilitate fine-grained, configurable guardrail enforcement with inheritance features and integration points for logging and contextual data.
